1583884012-us.title: TOO MANY ADS
1583884012-us.text: I’m not usually one to complain about ads, because I get it. If something is free, the creator has to generate income somehow. And you have to watch yet another ad before you can delete your pictures! And they’re the annoying kind too that take WAY too long and you need to jump through all the hoops of: “No, I don’t want the game.” “No I’m SURE I don’t want the game.” “NO I DO NOT WANT THE GAME.” They’re unbearable. 1583884012-us.title: Rip off when there are free alternatives
1583884012-us.text:
Update after Dev Response:
There are alternatives that do everything your pro subscription model does for free.  They do it better, and they have more things available for a subscription model that is less than a quarter for what you charge - and they do it with zero ads!!!

No matter how you try to justify it, $9 a week - that’s around $30 a month (!?!) - is absolutely ridiculous when your app only does one small thing.  That’s not worth a subscription fee.  A one time payment, maybe?  But even then there are others who do it better.
Either way, it screams that you are trying to rip off those who are willing to fall for it.  That instantly made this product and company that no one should trust.

$9 a week for an app that should be a $5 one time payment for a basic tool.

It’s not worth it, and there are free alternatives that do even more available!!
